newsitem.title: USA: Centralia, Wash. coal unit restart delayed to Fri.
newsitem.headline: Centralia, Wash. coal unit restart delayed to Fri.

text.p: The 670 megawatt (MW) unit 2 at the Centralia, Wash., coal-fired power plant will not be restarted as expected today but should be back on line Friday, a spokeswoman for Puget Sound Power and Light Co said Wednesday.
The unit has been down since Monday for repairs to a tube leak.
Puget is a minority partner in the Centralia project, which is operated by 47.5-percent owner PacifiCorp.
Centralia's other 670 MW unit was said to be operating normally.
